title: 第9章 臭臭的霍雨浩，跟踪狂徒
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

霍雨浩拉肚子确实是因为那颗玄水丹，不过并不是因为做了坏事。

玄水丹有洗筋伐髓的功效，会使得霍雨浩将身体里的垃圾排出来。所以不仅仅是拉肚子，他皮肤的毛孔里也渗出了一些黑色的物质。

“霍雨浩，你臭死了，快点去洗澡。”

“有吗？”

霍雨浩问了一下，他自己并闻不到有什么味道。

“你赶紧洗，不然不许睡觉。”

霍雨浩身上的味道实在是让人有些受不了，王冬儿直接选择离开宿舍。

等到宿舍里没什么味道之后，王冬儿才重新回来。

经过一晚上的冥想修炼，霍雨浩彻底将玄水丹的药效吸收完，魂力突破到十三级。

“太好了，王冬，我的魂力突破了！”

霍雨浩非常高兴，直接一下子抱着王冬蹦了起来。

王冬儿没有躲，反手抱住霍雨浩。

等到霍雨浩都觉得自己有些喘不过气来时，他才把王冬儿松开。

霍雨浩感觉王冬儿的身体软软的，抱起来很舒服。

“快点走吧，马上就要迟到了。”

“对哦，差点忘了。”

霍雨浩赶紧去洗漱一番。

两人慌慌忙忙的来到食堂吃了早餐，然后及时的进入教室上课。

课上教的这些内容，王冬儿前世就已经学过了，完全可以不用再学。

但她很珍惜陪在霍雨浩身边一起上课的日子。

霍雨浩认真地看着老师讲课，而王冬儿认真地看着霍雨浩的脸。

“你一直看着我做什么？”霍雨浩小声问道。

“因为你长得很好看啊。”

霍雨浩的脸一下子就红了，被一个男生夸长得好看，他总觉得有点怪怪的。

霍雨浩意识到不对劲的地方。

“王冬，我怎么感觉好像有谁在盯着我们？”

王冬儿朝着周围看了一圈，并没有发现什么不对劲的地方。

“没有吧，会不会是你感觉错了？”

霍雨浩挠挠头：“也许是吧。”

中午下课后，他们去食堂吃饭，霍雨浩感觉那种被盯着的感觉越来越强烈。

“王冬，真的有人盯着我们。”

此刻王冬儿也有这样的感觉：“先去吃饭，吃完饭再说。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Huo Yuhao's diarrhea was indeed due to the Xuanshui Pill, but it was not because of anything bad he did.

Xuanshui Dan has the effect of cleansing muscles and cutting marrow, which will make Huo Yuhao expel the garbage from his body.So not only did he have diarrhea, but some black substance also oozed from the pores of his skin.

"Huo Yuhao, you stink so much, go take a shower quickly."

"Is there any?"

Huo Yuhao asked, but he couldn't smell anything.

"Hurry up and wash up, or you won't be able to sleep."

The smell of Huo Yuhao was really unbearable, so Wang Donger chose to leave the dormitory directly.

Wang Donger didn't come back until there was no smell in the dormitory.

After a night of meditation practice, Huo Yuhao completely absorbed the effects of the Xuanshui Pill, and his soul power broke through to the thirteenth level.

"Great, Wang Dong, my soul power has broken through!"

Huo Yuhao was very happy and jumped up with Wang Dong in his arms.

Wang Donger did not hide, but hugged Huo Yuhao with her backhand.

When Huo Yuhao felt that he was out of breath, he let go of Wang Dong'er.

Huo Yuhao felt that Wang Donger's body was soft and comfortable to hold.

"Let's go quickly, we'll be late soon."

"Yeah, I almost forgot."

Huo Yuhao quickly went to wash up.

The two of them hurried to the cafeteria to have breakfast, and then entered the classroom in time for class.

Wang Donger had already learned these contents taught in class in his previous life, and there was no need to learn them again.

But she cherished the days she spent with Huo Yuhao in class.

Huo Yuhao looked at the teacher's lecture seriously, while Wang Dong'er looked at Huo Yuhao's face seriously.

"Why have you been looking at me?" Huo Yuhao asked in a low voice.

"Because you are very good-looking."

Huo Yuhao's face suddenly turned red. He always felt a little weird when a boy praised him for his good looks.

Huo Yuhao realized something was wrong.

"Wang Dong, why do I feel like someone is watching us?"

Wang Donger looked around and found nothing wrong.

"No, maybe you feel wrong?"

Huo Yuhao scratched his head: "Maybe."

After class at noon, they went to the cafeteria to eat. Huo Yuhao felt that the feeling of being stared at became more and more intense.

"Wang Dong, someone is really watching us."

At this moment, Wang Donger also felt like this: "Let's go eat first and then talk after eating."
